info.title: OpenAsy Risk API
info.summary: The risk register and vendor reviews, linked to controls and findings, with a history nobody edits.
info.description:
Every screen of risk uses this API, and so can your scripts and other OpenAsy products (ADR 0014). Within `/api/v1` changes are additive only; anything removed is deprecated first (ADR 0024). Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457).

Everything takes the session of a signed-in person or an API token, and each operation names the role it needs (`x-openasy-role`: viewer, editor, admin; ADR 0003). Other products open a risk from a finding with an API token with the editor role.

Sign-in, members and API tokens are under `/api/v1/auth`, provided by [@openasy/auth](https://github.com/openasy/auth#routes).

get.description:
The register, ordered by score and then by number.

Needs the viewer role.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `active` (everything not closed), `review-due`, or one of identified, assessing, treating, accepted, closed.

parameters.name: overdue
parameters.description: `true`: review date or acceptance has passed. `false`: the others.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches title, description, owner and tags.

200.description: Highest score first.

post.description:
Another product can open a risk from a finding with `external`; the same source and reference open one risk (ADR 0023).

Needs the editor role.

200.description: Already open for this external source and reference; a line was added to its history.

parameters.description: The risk's id or key such as R-3.

delete.description:
Deletes its links and its history.

Needs the admin role.

204.description: Deleted with its links and history.

post.description:
Accepting a risk is a decision somebody answers for: it needs a reason, an approver and an end date at most 366 days away. A closed risk cannot be accepted.

Needs the admin role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The risk's id or key such as R-3.

200.description: Accepted until the end date; after it the risk is review due.

post.description:
Refused for a closed risk, and for an accepted risk whose acceptance has run out: accept it again or change its status first.

Needs the editor role.

session.name: __Host-openasy-session
session.description: The browser session after signing in (`openasy-session` when risk runs on plain http://localhost). Requests that change something must come from the risk origin.

apiToken.description: An API token created under Settings → API tokens (`oa_risk_...`): one role, always an expiry (ADR 0003).

adminToken.description: Only when risk is started by its tests or a local script: one shared token with the admin role. A production install does not have it.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details.

RiskStatus.description: `review-due` is what an accepted risk becomes when its acceptance runs out. It is not set; it follows from the clock.

id.description: The product, as OpenAsy names it.

url.description: The address people open it at.

overdue.description: Open risks whose review date or acceptance has passed.

reviewDue.description: Accepted risks whose acceptance has run out.

source.description: The product that opened it, such as `dast`.

External.description: Names what a risk was opened for. The same source and reference open one risk.

overdue.description: Its review date has come, or its acceptance has run out.

links.description: Only when one risk is asked for.

nextCursor.description: Pass the previous page's nextCursor to get the next page.

expiresAt.description: In the future, at most 366 days away. The risk is review due from then.

product.description: The product the reference is in, such as `dast`.
